body:
Bumps the benchmark group in /experiments/benchmark with 1 update: [spacy](https://github.com/explosion/spaCy). Updates `spacy` from 3.8.16 to 3.8.18
Commits
  • 4331199 Set version to v3.8.18
  • 2b5f28d Fix spacy.CharEmbed.v1 registration and require Python 3.10
  • f0b029c Drop pip-based before-build step from cibuildwheel config
  • cdeae95 Require weasel>=1.0.1 and confection>=1.3.4
  • 14436a0 Exclude preshed 3.0.14
  • c33f6e6 Support Python 3.15, release v3.8.17
  • 6d51b88 Merge pull request #14054 from explosion/deps/spacy-transformers-2.0
  • a261327 Allow spacy-transformers v1.4.x and v2.0.x in transformers extra
  • c2dabfc Fix memory leak when adding an existing morph from a dict (#14041)
  • See full diff in compare view
